- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Migration.Import.ImportContext`

### Properties

#### TargetFieldMetadata

```text
PPDS.Migration.Import.FieldMetadataCollection TargetFieldMetadata { get; }
```

Gets the target environment field metadata. Used to validate which fields are valid for create/update operations.


#### Options

```text
PPDS.Migration.Import.ImportOptions Options { get; }
```

Gets the import options.


#### StateTransitions

```text
PPDS.Migration.Import.StateTransitionCollection StateTransitions { get; }
```

Gets the collection of state transitions to apply after record import. Thread-safe for concurrent access during parallel import.


#### Plan

```text
PPDS.Migration.Models.ExecutionPlan Plan { get; }
```

Gets the execution plan defining tier order and deferred fields.


#### IdMappings

```text
PPDS.Migration.Models.IdMappingCollection IdMappings { get; }
```

Gets the shared ID mapping collection. This is populated during entity import and read during deferred field and relationship processing. Thread-safe for concurrent access.


#### Data

```text
PPDS.Migration.Models.MigrationData Data { get; }
```

Gets the migration data containing records to import.


#### Progress

```text
PPDS.Migration.Progress.IProgressReporter Progress { get; }
```

Gets the progress reporter (never null; defaults to P:PPDS.Migration.Progress.IProgressReporter.Silent).


#### Warnings

```text
PPDS.Migration.Progress.IWarningCollector Warnings { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the warning collector shared across the import pipeline. Phase processors write non-fatal warnings here (e.g., skipped role mappings) so PPDS.Migration.Import.TieredImporter can surface them in the final result. Defaults to a local PPDS.Migration.Progress.WarningCollector so phase tests do not need to wire it.


#### OutputManager

```text
PPDS.Migration.Progress.ImportOutputManager OutputManager { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the optional output manager for checkpoint logging. When set, tier starts, entity completions, and phase transitions are logged to the progress file.


#### SourceEntityTypeCodes

```text
System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2<System.Int32,System.String> SourceEntityTypeCodes { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the source Entity Type Code to logical name mapping. Used by DuplicateRuleHandler to remap baseentitytypecode and matchingentitytypecode fields. Key is the source ETC (int), value is the entity logical name.


#### TargetEntityTypeCodes

```text
System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2<System.String,System.Int32> TargetEntityTypeCodes { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the target logical name to Entity Type Code mapping. Used by DuplicateRuleHandler to remap baseentitytypecode and matchingentitytypecode fields. Key is the entity logical name, value is the target ETC (int).


#### TargetRootBusinessUnitId

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Guid> TargetRootBusinessUnitId { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the target environment&#x27;s root business unit ID. Used by BusinessUnitHandler to remap the root BU during import.
